name: Name
author: Author
noListsMsg: You don't have lists yet, lets create one.
noItemsInList: This list doesn't have items yet, lets create one.
searchByN/A/G: Search by name, author, or genre
editOrRateText: To edit or rate, swipe from left to right to see the corresponding buttons.
deleteText: To delete, swipe from right to left to see the delete button.
openTutorialText: To see the tutorial again, tap on the question mark button at the bottom left corner in the Item list of one of your lists.
settingsText: Tap the cog icon in 'Your lists' screen to open settings and find light/dark mode toggle and language selector.
filterText: Tap the funnel icon to open filtering options.
sortText: Tap this icon to open sorting options.
randomChoiseText: Clicking the random choise button at the bottom right of the screen will select a random non-rated element of your list with filters applied if applicable, if all elements are rated, then one of the rated will be selected and shown.
